nodes.rationale: Derived artifacts must be reproducible from document version, chunker version/config, embedding model/version and index configuration.

Authorization applied when choosing what to index (GUEST_PUBLIC_POLICY)
nodes.rationale: Only eligible documents are chunked or embedded; payload carries access_scope, tenant_id and owner_user_id for retrieval filtering.

AccessContext(role, tenant_id) with blank tenant refused
check_hit (fail-closed re-check, second line of defense)
DenseIndex (read-only binding to collection and -settings record)
build_retriever (only place a strategy name becomes a retriever)
HybridRetriever (dense leg then BM25 leg at candidate depth)
IndexIdentity (collection, index_version, embedder pair, fake flag, source qdrant|lexical_file)
FallbackRetriever (BM25 serves when hybrid primary is unavailable)
open_retrieval -> OpenedRetrieval (single wiring function for both CLIs)
Dense query flow (load_runtime_settings, build_embedder, DenseIndex.open, resolve_access, embed_query, filter, check_hit)
Authorization filter is part of the Qdrant query so unauthorized points never leave the store
nodes.rationale: The query text, embedder and evaluation cases cannot change it; check_hit is a second line of defense.

nodes.label: Binding: embedder model ID, revision, vector size, normalization, fake flag and index_version must equal recorded IndexSettings
No language filter, score threshold or reranking yet
Baseline runner (refuses fake index without --allow-fake; HitRate@k, Recall@k, MRR, p50/p95, min(1,k/N) random expectation)
store.py (SQLite FTS5: chunks table, chunk_terms FTS5 table, settings row; LexicalIndex.open, bind_to, search)
lexical/cli.py (make index-lexical writes only git-ignored file)
freshness.py (verify_fresh, chunk digest recomputed from repository)
Lexical file is a derived artifact, one per collection, bound by identity and chunk digest
nodes.rationale: Bound either to the dense index (bind_to) or to configuration and repository (check_identity plus verify_fresh).

nodes.label: Hybrid retrieval flow (dense leg + BM25 leg -> rrf_fuse -> top_k, score_kind rrf, leg ranks)
Fusion sees only authorized hits and fails closed; any leg error propagates (no single-leg fallback inside HybridRetriever)
BM25 statistics (IDF, avg length) computed over every row of a lexical file
nodes.rationale: Production file holds only eligible public chunks so it reveals nothing; a future roles spec needs one lexical file per access scope.

nodes.label: bm25 builds no embedder and no Qdrant client

Target RAG query flow (User -> FastAPI -> validation -> AccessContext -> LanguageContext -> retrieval -> RRF -> reranker -> context builder -> answerability -> prompt -> Bedrock -> citation validation)
Authorization applied inside each retriever before fusion, never after RRF, reranking or generation
nodes.rationale: Unauthorized content never reaches fusion, reranker, context builder or LLM.

nodes.label: Fallback open/query flow (open_retrieval -> FallbackRetriever -> BM25 on RetrievalUnavailableError)
Eligible failures: Qdrant connect/network, Qdrant timeout, model load/download failure with network __cause__
nodes.rationale: Nothing else falls back: HTTP status errors incl 5xx, missing collection, settings mismatch, stale lexical file, missing bge-m3 extra, authorization and SQLite errors all exit 2.

nodes.label: Explicit dense and bm25 never fall back
Policy: per query, no state, no circuit breaker
nodes.rationale: Worst case about query_timeout_s per query when Qdrant hangs; open-time failure means BM25 serves the whole run with no per-query dense attempt.

nodes.label: Standalone freshness proves lexical file matches repository, not live Qdrant (D060)
nodes.rationale: Rereads every eligible document at each open; revisit for large corpus.

nodes.label: Marking and evaluation: make retrieve fallback line, eval-retrieval result 2.2, eval-compare by served strategy
Fallback adds no authorization logic; same ResolvedAccess passed unchanged; RetrievalAuthorizationError never caught
Planned fallbacks: query rewrite failure, reranker failure, Langfuse unavailable, generation failure, weak evidence

nodes.rationale: Ineligible content written only there, never into a real index; failure exit 1, broken harness exit 2.
